headline: Aartech Solonics' subsidiary signs MoU with Shenzhen Titan Smart Energy
hook: New partnership targets Indian energy storage space
summary: Aartech Solonics Limited announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Faradigm Ultracapacitors Pvt. Ltd., has signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Shenzhen Titan Smart Energy Technology Co. Ltd. The agreement explores energy storage cooperation within the Indian market. This collaboration brings foreign clean-tech expertise to a domestic subsidiary focusing on advanced energy solutions. Retail investors in niche clean-tech segments should watch for definitive agreements and commercialization updates.

why_it_matters: Subsidiary expansion into clean-tech storage could drive future growth.
